en: The Triplet of the Wholesome, the Triplet of Seeing as the Cause.
Dependent on an unwholesome state whose root is to be abandoned by vision, there arises a non-unwholesome state whose root is not to be abandoned by vision, by way of root-condition.
(Abbreviated. Under root-condition there are three; under predominance-condition there are three ... pe ... under non-disappearance-condition there are three.
Dependent on an unwholesome state whose root is to be abandoned by cultivation, there arises a non-unwholesome state whose root is not to be abandoned by cultivation... [and so forth].
A state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; three under predominance … pe … three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on an unwholesome state rooted in a cause to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation, there arises a wholesome state not rooted in a cause to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root … pe … three under non-disappearance.

Conditioned by an indeterminate state whose root is to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation, there arises an indeterminate state whose root is to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation, by way of root-condition.
(Abbreviated. Under root there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance there are three.
